sentences.en: She was elected as the class representative and now organizes group activities.
sentences.zh: 她被选为班级代表，现在负责组织小组活动。

sentences.en: The class representative reminded everyone to clean up after the party.
sentences.zh: 班长提醒大家聚会后要把场地清理干净。

sentences.en: He volunteered to be the new class representative this semester.
sentences.zh: 他主动报名担任了本学期的班级代表。
